title: Judge who apologized to accused would-be Trump assassin lights up DOJ in Hunter Biden FBI case
summary: Magistrate Judge Zia M. Faruqui tossed DOJ obstruction charges against two ex-FBI officials after prosecutors filed unsigned complaints at midnight.

title: 175 Democrats demand Trump admin stop Ilhan Omar investigation, warn it could hurt her re-election bid
summary: Rep. Pramila Jayapal led 175 House Democrats in accusing DHS and DOJ of weaponizing the federal investigation into Ilhan Omar's immigration history.

title: Trump accused of trying to 'force' Senate candidate on voters as GOP feud erupts
summary: Ralph Norman refuses to campaign for Darline Graham, accusing Trump of trying to force his hand-picked Senate candidate on South Carolina voters.

title: Kamala Harris calls Trump administration 'most callous and corrupt' in American history
summary: Kamala Harris called the Trump White House the "most callous and corrupt" administration in history while campaigning for David Crowley in Wisconsin.

title: Trump supporters confront Iran, affordability concerns with a message for critics: 'Give him time'
summary: Trump rally-goers in Perry, Georgia, defend the president as gas prices hit $3.66 per gallon amid the Iran war and growing affordability concerns.

title: Trump won this reliably red state by double digits. Now a deadlocked race is bringing him back
summary: A Fox News poll shows Ken Paxton and James Talarico tied at 49% in the Texas Senate race as Trump heads to Lubbock and Corpus Christi to rally GOP voters.

title: Trump-backed senator admits GOP faces nightmare scenario in state Republicans haven't lost in 90 years
summary: Roger Marshall warns that losing Kansas could hand Senate control to Chuck Schumer as Adam Hamilton makes the race uncomfortably close for the GOP.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to why removing Ilhan Omar from Congress could be harder than Trump expects
summary: President Trump is urging Rep. Ilhan Omar to resign as the Justice Department investigates potential immigration fraud, raising questions about whether House Republicans could take action against the Minnesota Democrat.

title: Hornets to retire jersey of Muggsy Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history, in 2027
summary: Muggsy Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history at 5-foot-3, will have his No. 1 jersey retired by the Charlotte Hornets on Feb. 11, 2027.

title: Arizona coach gives back in big way by buying fans $2,000 worth of tequila and 1,000 game tickets
summary: Brent Brennan's wild weekend included a $2,000 bar tab at "Dirtbag's" and 1,000 donated tickets for local youth ahead of Arizona's Big 12 win.
